decision: Zac-Kyoti's stock OS 1.40C fixes (MIT) in every Octatrack base, as octabam pins them at 2cd3109 (its modules batch-bugfixes and erase-empty-trigless-locks): EMPTY_PATTERN_LED_FIX, PART_CHANGE_CARRYOVER_FIX and ERASE_EMPTY_TRIGLESS_LOCKS. The three sources and his LICENSE are copied unchanged into vendor/kyoti-stock-fixes/. The base builds its copies in sdk/machines/octatrack/elekloader/stock-fixes/, which differ only in their entry labels and the Part fix's two snapshot bytes (in .bss); sdk/tests/test_stock_fixes.py checks that and, with ColdFire binutils, the bytes his manifests pin. His MIDI_PLAYS_FREE_FIX (patch_trigscale.s) is not imported: Direct Jump Kyoti carries it at 0x4009b6f2, and the base's own entry (plays_free.s) follows his analysis on the next instruction, so the two never patch the same bytes. Not imported: his manifests, standalone builders, emulator tools and the rest of his repository.
